purpose: Qualify equal-dimension coarse Richards D3 and D2 as numerical comparators for DYN0A by temporal refinement only, after the base 0.0008-day route blocked on local residual qualification under perturbed fixed-flux forcing.

coarse_D3.representative_block: local residual within prior integrated allowance

coarse_D2.representative_block: local residual within prior integrated allowance

observed_preflight.interpretation: The equal-dimension spatial comparators are not yet scientifically usable outside equilibrium. Temporal qualification is required before any LARE-vs-coarse-Richards fidelity claim.

frozen_physics.bottom_boundary: fixed downward flux q_bottom = initial equilibrium K0

temporal_refinement.forcing_rule: Forcing remains piecewise constant over the original 0.0008-day observation interval. Substeps do not move forcing change times.
temporal_refinement.state_sampling: Only committed states at the original 0.0008-day observation grid are used for comparator error and convergence assessment.
temporal_refinement.seed_policy: Use the same initial state and seed authority as the existing DYN0A Reference harness; no spatial or constitutive retuning.

numerical_policy.first_attempt: Use the current admitted Reference Richards route and the same strict-first diagnostics as DYN0A.
numerical_policy.fallback: No new fallback class is introduced. Any retry/fallback already admitted by the parent research harness may be used unchanged; otherwise fail closed.
temporal_convergence_metrics: max absolute per-layer storage difference at observation times
mean absolute per-layer storage difference at observation times
max absolute bottom-flux difference at observation times
max absolute total-storage difference at observation times
numerical_policy.comparator_reference_rule: For each geometry/case, the finest successful internal_dt route is the temporary numerical reference. Successive coarser successful routes are compared against it.
numerical_policy.qualify_case_rule: A case is comparator-qualified when at least two successive finest routes are successful and their observation-grid state difference is finite and non-increasing with refinement. No absolute hydrological acceptance threshold is introduced here.
numerical_policy.strict_failure_rule: If a case remains numerically blocked at 0.00005 day, classify BLOCKED_COARSE_RICHARDS_TEMPORAL_QUALIFICATION rather than altering the spatial grid or fallback policy.

hydrological_comparison_after_qualificat.fine_reference: existing 16x10 cm DYN0A fixed-flux fine Reference artifact
hydrological_comparison_after_qualificat.D3: compare temporally-qualified coarse Richards D3 and LARE D3 against the same projected fine Reference trajectory
hydrological_comparison_after_qualificat.D2: compare temporally-qualified coarse Richards D2 and LARE D2 against the same projected fine Reference trajectory
hydrological_comparison_after_qualificat.common_case_rule: Only cases qualified for fine Reference, LARE finest Heun, and temporally-qualified coarse Richards enter the paired comparison.

invalid_prior_run.observation: The temporal-substep harness recomputed subinterval start times independently. Even exact EQ D3/D2, known to complete 1024 observations in the frozen Reference artifact, failed after a few steps with 'pre-attempt committed time'.
invalid_prior_run.diagnosis: Floating-point time-coordinate construction caused bitwise mismatch with the committed transaction time. This is a harness defect, not a Richards numerical qualification result.

repair.rule: Use the actually committed interval start as sub_t0. Intermediate substeps advance sequentially, and the final substep of every observation interval is snapped to the original preregistered observation boundary seed_time + step*0.0008 day.
repair.baseline_requirement: For substeps=1, all previously qualified EQ cases must reproduce the frozen 1024-step Reference behavior before any substeps>1 result is interpreted.
